notes.title: Implemented more detailed terrain generation! Added shield-bearing soldiers!
notes.content:
Update Notice

A new update has arrived! In Zundamon Castle, two new terrain detail modes (8m and 4m scale) have been added for creating more detailed Japanese terrain. Additionally, shield soldiers have been added as allies. In the next update, cavalry units are scheduled to be introduced.

[h2][New Features & Specification Changes][/h2]

[*] Japanese terrain generation now supports 8m and 4m scales
[*] Ninjas were weaker than other enemies, so a new ability was added: "Do not fall when attacked"
[*] Increased the number and level of ninja raids on higher difficulties (Adjusted slightly based on feedback from the beta version)
[*] Strengthened earthen walls to make them fire-resistant
[*] Added a warning note regarding 8m and 4m terrain generation: “Water representation may be unstable.” (Although existing river data for up to 16m scale was expanded, terrain issues occurred, so some roughness remains for now.)
[*] Optimized unit movement processing for better performance
[*] Production limits can now be set via long press and direct input
[/olist]

[*] Fixed a bug where training ground sounds would loop and overlap, causing the volume to increase.
[*] Fixed an issue where the number of Zundamon requiring rations in the top-right display would incorrectly decrease by the number of new recruits when building a barracks

[*] Fixed a bug where all buildings would default to the same recipe after loading if a default recipe had been set

notes.title: Official Update: Now Compatible with the World Map!
notes.content:
Update Announcement

Starting with this version, Zundamon Castle is now compatible with the World Map!
By looking up the latitude and longitude of your favorite places in the world using Google Maps or similar services, you can now build your castle based on real-world terrain.

Note: When starting a New Game, please select "Choose Latitude and Longitude (World)".
To find coordinates, search for a place name in Google Maps, then right-click on the map to display the latitude and longitude. Click on the coordinates to copy them, then paste them into the latitude/longitude fields in the game.
Note: Terrain generation may not work properly in extreme latitudes, such as the Arctic or Antarctic regions.

[h2]【Content Additions & Specification Changes】[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Terrain generation now supports the world map
[*] In World Map Mode, terrain blocks like sand and rocks are now placed more closely according to the local geography
[*] The flammability of plaster walls has been adjusted upward to 0% chance of catching fire (was previously 1%)
[/olist]

[h2]【Bug Fixes】[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Fixed a bug where the bottom of the ground could be dug through
[*] Fixed an issue where, if the base was set to reject "influence", influence income per turn would fall to the ground and would not be converted. Now, "Influence", "Military Points", and "Money from defeating enemies" that are granted directly to the base will ignore storage settings and be stored properly
[/olist]

notes.title: Major Update: Worker Zundamon Now Eats! Take on the New Trials Challenge!
notes.content:
Update Notice

Starting from this version, Worker Zundamons now eat meals and drink waters. Additionally, a new high-difficulty post-clear content called "Trials" has been added.

[h2]【New Features & System Changes】[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Official implementation of the "Trials" feature (You can select trials from the New Game settings screen after clearing the game. Selecting a higher-level trial will automatically apply all lower-level trials as well. Trial 10 is the highest difficulty).
[*] Added "No regular raids" option to raid frequency settings in New Game options.
[*] Added "Peaceful" option to difficulty settings in New Game options.
[*] Implemented a feature where workers consume food and water (to maintain gameplay even in peaceful mode).
[*] Implemented the ability to freely change workers’ jobs.
[*] Changed all worker spawns to occur only from the main base.
[*] Increased the performance of food and water production facilities to compensate for the fact that workers now consume food. Also increased the initial supplies of water and food.
[*] Modified food production facilities to produce food every cycle, instead of only when the growth rate reaches 100%.
[*] Adjusted regular raid difficulty scaling across all difficulty levels in response to the new worker consumption system.
[*] Added new dialogue lines for the appearance of battering rams.
[*] Slightly reduced the movement speed of battering rams, slightly increased their HP, and decreased their attack speed.
[*] In Endless Battle mode, from wave 50 onward, the number of enemies spawning per second will gradually increase (to reduce processing load, enemies appear gradually, but their spawn rate has now been increased. This increases enemy density and raises the difficulty).
[*] The job settings screen now always displays the number of tasks under each job title.
[*] Reduced processing load for pathfinding and unit rendering.
[*] Adjusted projectile lines from gap walls to start slightly in front of the wall for better line-of-sight.
[*] Added an option to keep regular raids active even after game completion.
[/olist]

[h2]【Bug Fixes】[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Fixed a bug where buildings sometimes received more items than necessary when transporting them.
[*] Fixed an issue in ver0.501 where time progressed abnormally fast.
[*] Fixed an issue in ver0.5022 where changing a worker’s job could cause an excessive increase in worker numbers.
[*] Fixed an issue in ver0.5023 where no challenges occurred when “No regular raids” was selected.
[*] Fixed an issue where certain mountains or lakes had missing survey data from the Geospatial Information Authority of Japan, resulting in unnatural terrain generation. The missing data is now supplemented with alternative data to generate more natural terrain.
[/olist]

notes.title: Update: Temperature, enhanced terrain generation, Level 1 lock feature
notes.content:
Update Announcement for Zundamon Castle
We have officially rolled out features that were in beta since May 29: the temperature system and enhanced terrain generation!

[h2]Main Additions and Specification Changes[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Implemented a system where temperature varies based on selected latitude and longitude, using data from the Japan Meteorological Agency (JMA). (As a result, random terrain generation has been removed.)
[*] Improved terrain generation so that rivers are properly generated even at zoom levels of 32m/16m.
[*] Added a foundation stone block.
[*] To distinguish them from Ashigaru units, Ninja Saboteurs will no longer deploy shield walls. Instead, they now completely ignore buildings when pathfinding. Additionally, all ninja units have slightly increased swimming and climbing speeds.
[*] Temporarily removed the feature where rainwater remains on rocks even after the weather clears.
[*] Slightly optimized pathfinding performance.
[*] When hovering over the auto-intercept range button, the interception range will now be displayed.
[*] Changed mechanics so that when friendly units step onto tiles with enemy structures like shield walls, those structures are instantly destroyed. Also updated cannon units to ignore shield walls and target enemies directly, destroying shield walls only at the impact site.
[*] Units that are poor at swimming or climbing will now take routes that avoid water and high terrain more than before.
[*] Added a special option to reduce processing load on large maps by combining the warehouse and housing into a single structure at the main base.
[/olist]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Fixed a bug where building repairs would continue even if the building became submerged.
[/olist]

notes.title: May 29 Beta Update – Temperature Data Implemented!

Zundamon Castle Beta Version Update Notice
This includes the updates from April 25 as well.

[h1]May 29 – Beta Version Notice[/h1]
[h2][Additions & Specification Changes][/h2]
[olist]
[*] Implemented a system that applies climate based on coordinates using data from the Japan Meteorological Agency (using the nearest AMeDAS data, with slight adjustments to reflect the colder climate of the Sengoku period).
[*] Changed the non-operational condition of fields and rice paddies to "stop production when the temperature falls below 10°C". The double cropping effect is changed to "can produce until 0°C".
[*] Modified processing to make the shapes of 32m and 16m block sizes more accurate. Rivers are now displayed correctly even at these scales.
[*] Changed the occurrence of rain and snow to be based on actual regional precipitation probabilities. (Typhoons are not yet adjusted.)
[*] Added a special option to fix both enemy and ally levels at 1 (for those who want to test castle performance based purely on layout).
[*] Increased movement speed of cavalry units.
[*] Reduced the number of deployable shields per enemy unit from 4 to 3.
[*] Slightly changed how labor Zundamons are displayed to reduce processing load.
[/olist]

[h1]April 25 – Standard Version Notice[/h1]
[h2][Additions & Specification Changes][/h2]
[*] Fixed the progress bar for Zundamon to always face the camera as before.
[*] Fixed default soldier settings so they are applied in other play sessions as well.
[*] Reduced minor processing loads.
[*] Improved block seams to connect more naturally.
[*] Modified the UI so when selecting multiple buildings, you can change whether to include assigned soldiers all at once.

[h2][Bug Fixes][/h2]
[olist]
[*] Fixed a bug where the “Penetration Power” icon in the dojo was displayed incorrectly.
[*] Fixed a bug where spring blocks were not displaying as fresh green.
[*] Fixed a bug where the camera would not move when displaying the map for latitude/longitude selection in a new game.
[*] Fixed a bug where using the kitchen turret would incur excessive maintenance costs for elite soldiers.
[*] Fixed a bug where the lumberjack hut would be dismantled immediately after construction.
[*] Fixed a bug where debris from defeated enemies remained and caused lag during consecutive battles in a single day.
[*] Fixed a bug where game performance dropped or BGM stopped when bullets were generated (caused by sound effect processing).
[*] Fixed a bug where the game would freeze when cooking rice in the kitchen turret if the rice was consumed and ran out.
[*] Fixed a bug where rapidly right-clicking while saving would make the UI disappear and the game unresponsive.
[/olist]

notes.title: April 10: Added feature to set the maximum number of enemies, bug fixes.

notes.title: 1/22 Addition of Priority Feature, Increase in HP for Ally Units and Building
notes.content:
Update Announcement for Zundamon Castle
This is a summary of the updates that took place on 1/21 and 1/22.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45310811/51531fe8bb2d0875824478a81a3b56597f407216.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45310811/d5379fda05cdc7c97065efaf10662008479b4de7.png[/img][/url]
[h2][Content Additions & Changes][/h2]
[olist]
[+] Implemented priority feature
[+] Increased HP for Kiridan, Itako, Zunko, and Melee Zundamon (The level calculation bug was fixed, and as a result, the difficulty was slightly higher, so this adjustment aims to ease that). We believe that battles where units can exchange blows are more interesting than immediate deaths from being hit, so we will continue to balance the game in this direction.
[+] Changed the gravity handling of ally units. Also, optimized the movement processing.
[+] Changed the enemy list text in Challenges to a more readable color.
[/olist]
[h2][Bug Fixes][/h2]
[olist]
[+] Fixed an issue where the cost display for level 10 upgrades for soldiers was showing as level 11.
[+] Fixed a bug where farming activities that continued from autumn were not immediately interrupted when entering winter.
[+] Fixed a bug where the position of the fishmonger worker was offset.
[+] Fixed an issue where, after loading, the enemy in the challenge would reflect the difficulty from before the load.
[+] Fixed a bug where no items were obtained when digging a dirt path.
[+] Fixed a bug where the effects of snow and heavy snow were applied to work speeds as well.
[/olist]

notes.title: Game optimization and bug fixes
notes.content:
[b]Update Notice for Zundamon Castle![/b]
This is a summary of the updates from January 4th, 5th, and 6th.

[h2][Content Additions & Specification Changes][/h2]
[olist]
[*]Optimized pathfinding to reduce load.
[*]Adjusted the models of walls and gates to ensure they fit together smoothly.
[*]Added "Supply Point" and "Combat Point" details to the soldier panel. Adjusted the soldier operation panel so it does not overlap with the soldier panel.
[*]Increased the effort required for sales at the port due to the excessive power of selling, making some balance adjustments.
[*]Changed the infinite battles after clearing the game so that they begin immediately after booking, even if the battle frequency is set to every 3 turns
[*]Modified the behavior so that soldiers do not return to the combat start position during turns with no battles.
[*]Temporarily hid the panel that appears above the cursor during construction as it was interfering with construction operations.
[/olist]

[h2][Bug Fixes][/h2]
[olist]
[*]Fixed a bug where bulk armor changes were not functioning.
[*]Fixed a bug where the game would freeze when selecting a troop after firing a soldier from a troop.
[*]Fixed a bug where equip supply workers were not tracking units.
[*]Fixed a bug where the range selection box was displayed in incorrect positions depending on screen resolution.
[*]Fixed a bug where the date on the UI did not progress during turns with no battles.
[/olist]

notes.title: 12/15 update (Camera option added, fire extinguishing feature change)
notes.content:
[Important Notice]
From this version onward, the "fire extinguishing" feature has been changed, and fire extinguishing workers have been added. To extinguish fires, please increase the number of fire extinguishing workers.

[h2]New Features[/h2]

[olist]
[*] Added options on the second page to adjust camera blur strength, zoom sensitivity, and movement speed.
[*] Separated fire extinguishing tasks into a specific job for fire extinguishing workers (previously, any nearby worker would handle this).
[*] Increased the movement speed of soldiers during combat (may become extremely fast in some environments).
[/olist]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[olist]
[*] Fixed a bug where the game would freeze if a worker went off the map when the worksite was near the map edge.
[*] Fixed a bug where the defense rate for custom MOD characters could only be set to 0 or 100.
[*] Fixed a bug where unit stat increases from technologies were repeatedly applied every time the tech panel was opened and closed.
[*] Fixed a bug where formation mode would persist after a defeat in combat.
[/olist]

Since the camera's movement speed and blur can now be adjusted, close-up shots just above the ground are easier to do than before. If you reduce the blur, change the height with the XZ keys, and rotate the camera up and down to get closer to the ground, you can achieve significant zoom. Feel free to try it out!

notes.content:

notes.title: Voxel Shogun Early Access Start!
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience! Although the release was slightly delayed due to a Steam re-review, we are excited to announce that the Early Access for Voxel Castle Kiritan officially started on December 7th, Japan time!

At this point, you can enjoy playing through the main storyline of the game. If you enjoy the game, even if you haven't finished the story yet, I’d be really happy if you could leave a review or share screenshots!

After the release, we plan to gradually implement features such as expanding the mod elements to allow for custom user-made units and buildings, adding additional storylines, and introducing external clans. We also want to add features like having Kiritan and others talk with voice, and feeding famous samurai (like Nobunaga) Zundamochi to recruit them as allies. Additionally, our 3D designer, Tanomira, will be gradually creating decorative buildings, so the visual elements will continue to improve.

Now, please enjoy playing Voxel Shogun Kiritan Castle!
